answer: Proof of Stake mechanisms require AI agents to lock capital, creating an atlas of verifiable ownership that maps digital identities to tangible value. Much like a river dictates the flow of assets, this scarcity renders Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to swarm the network like a sparrow would find the cost of acquiring sufficient stake to influence consensus exceeds the expected gains, thereby ensuring that economic gravity maintains the security of the distributed system.
